title: No BG value on wear complication with "640G / Eversence" as HW Data source
body:
I use the patched Dexcom G6 App.
BG values go to AAPS and AAPS broadcasts it back to Xdrip when using "640G / Eversence" as HW Data source.
On Wear complication, there is no BG shown (NULL NULL ()) in this particiliar case (otherwise wear complication works).

comments.body:
@gregorybel Is this still the case?
What do others do?

@Navid200 still using my old self patched xdrip so I dont know if issue is still there.
Maybe similar to #325

If you are the only one who needs this and you have already found a solution, I don't see the point of leaving this open.
If you like to share your solution, I guess you can open a pull request?

Please do. I believe I have been experiencing this same issue just without AAPS in between. Using BYODA to Xdrip+ with 640G / Eversence as the data source. Seems to work on the Xdrip watchface, just not the complications as in #325.  

Edit: After giving it a shot, seems like @gregorybel's fix is working on my end.
You can reopen this of course.  But, would you please make sure there is no other issue older than this that is reporting the same problem or anything related?
